# OCSDNET

> OCSDNET catalyzes open and collaborative science for development opportunities in the Global South through research, advocacy, and community practice.

OCSDNET is a network dedicated to promoting inclusive, equitable, and open science practices tailored to the needs and contexts of the Global South. The organization coordinates research across four thematic areas and brings together international partners, indigenous knowledge systems, and development-focused initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Open Science
- Global South
- Collaborative Science
- Development
- Indigenous Knowledge
- Open Access
- Research Equity
- Citizen Science
- Open Hardware
- Situated Openness
- Community Development
- Climate Change Adaptation
- Academic Publishing

## About OCSDNET

- [OCSDNET Homepage](https://ocsdnet.org): OCSDNET homepage promoting open and collaborative science for development in the Global South
- [Open Science Manifesto](https://ocsdnet.org/manifesto/open-science-manifesto): OCSDNET's seven-principle open science manifesto for inclusive, equitable science
- [The Team](https://ocsdnet.org/about-ocsdnet/the-team): Team members, advisors, and organizational leadership of OCSDNET

## Research & Thematic Areas

- [Thematic Research Areas](https://ocsdnet.org/thematic-areas): OCSDNET's four thematic research areas and communities of practice
- [OCSDNET Projects Directory](http://ocsdnet.org/ocsdnet-projects): Directory of OCSDNET research projects organized by four thematic areas

## Featured Projects

- [Indigenous Knowledge and Climate Change Adaptation](http://ocsdnet.org/projects/natural-justice-empowering-indigenous-peoples-and-knowledge-systems-related-to-climate): Natural Justice project on indigenous knowledge and Paris Agreement climate policy
- [Open Science and Community Development in Brazil](http://ocsdnet.org/projects/ibict-instituto-brasileiro-de-informacao-em-ciencia-e-tecnologia-okbr-open-knowledge-brasil-participating-institution): IBICT and Open Knowledge Brasil project on open science and community development
- [Open Access and Academic Publishing in Argentina](http://ocsdnet.org/projects/conicetfundacion-azara): CONICET and Fundación Azara project on open access STS studies and academic publishing
